positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Risk Platform Engineering: 
Providing real-time risk decisioning, payment fraud detection, bot + device fingerprinting, risk profiling for all of Adobe's flagship products (Firefly, Stock, Sign, Checkout, etc.)

Commerce Engineering (Order Processing and Fulfillment)
- designed and built several Commerce platform features: Pause/resume contract scheduling ($XXM ARR), app store subscriptions ($XXM ARR), undo cancellation ($XXM ARR), free offer promotions ($XM ARR)
- Commerce AI agent: org-wide hackathon-winning agent utilizing RAG, memory, tool-calling for E2E checkout, product discovery, upsell, and Paypal-integration through chat interface
- led Commerce MCP project: unified interface for AI-assisted support, log analysis, and observability

Payments Engineering
- Enabling payment vendors, LPMs, wallets
- led migration to Kubernetes-native CI/CD pipeline (Argo) with infra-as-code

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
Held various roles over 3 years: Development VP, Internal Affairs VP, Project Lead, etc.

Valley Consulting Group (VCG) is a UC Berkeley based management consulting firm working exclusively with industry-leading technology companies in the Silicon Valley. VCG provides strategic solutions to vital business challenges faced by its clients. VCG is composed of UC Berkeley's brightest undergraduates; past clients include Google, Microsoft, Spotify, Nike, Dropbox, LinkedIn, Airbnb and more.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Working on the Payments team within Commerce Experience Engineering

positions.title: Data Engineer Intern
positions.description: Breakthrough is a strategic transportation partner empowering shippers with data, technology, and market knowledge to reduce cost, create fair partnerships, and improve transportation network efficiency and sustainability. I worked as a data engineer team on the backend data engineering team.

positions.title: Data Science Consultant
positions.description:
•Developed machine learning techniques (k-means, PCA, logistic regression, random forest) to perform unsupervised customer segmentation analysis on more than 1,000,000 Roku Remote Voice users over an eight-week timespan
•Built consumer profiles of distinct Roku Voice user groups, significantly increasing Roku Voice product penetration

positions.title: Data Privacy Consultant
positions.description: Tech Consulting-- high level: Privacy & Trust, Data Portability, Cookie Controls, Mobile and Desktop platforms, Competitor UI/UX Research, Web Scraping

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Elear Solutions is a cutting-edge tech company and makers of COCO - a consumer peer-to-peer IoE platform built for data privacy. Their focus in decentralizing networking architectures awarded them a top 10 best Indian Peer to Peer company. As a software engineering intern, I worked on a Python implementation of COCO SDK to expand the developer community to Python developers and Raspberry Pi hobbyists

positions.title: Academic Intern
positions.description: Data 8 is one of UC Berkeley's most popular courses, bridging the gap between real-world experience and data-focused analytical thinking. As an academic intern, I assisted a 30-student lab section with computer programming, statistical, and machine learning concepts through hands-on projects and weekly labs (using Python via Jupyter Notebook). I also monitored an online queue, helping students debug their code or answer conceptual questions.

company.name: UC Berkeley Division of Computing, Data Science, and Society
